task.description: Resolve the blocker reported by WF02-adp01 step 04: integration failure TC-ES-07-01 archive retention expectation (assert n >= 1 failed) in tests/integration/event_store_integration_test.zig. Diagnose root cause and apply a fix that restores ES-07 retention behavior without regressing ADP-01 tenant-aware event store logic. Validate with zig build, zig build test, and zig build test-integration. Keep change scope minimal and update/add tests as needed to make the behavior deterministic.
acceptance_criteria: zig build, zig build test, and zig build test-integration pass
No regression introduced to ADP-01 tenant behavior
Issue report and handoff result include root cause and prevention note

result.summary: Fixed A_LOGIC_ERROR in event-store archival: ADP-01 added tenant_id to events_archive but archive() still used INSERT ... SELECT *, NOW(), causing column-order mismatch and swallowed SQL failures that left TC-ES-07-01 with zero archived rows. Replaced archival INSERTs with explicit target/source column mapping (including tenant_id and archived_at) and made keep_days/fallback cutoffs boundary-inclusive to remove immediate-archive timing flakiness.
